hero.title: A quiet, renovated hotel in the heart of Salalah
hero.lead: Rooms, suites and flats for a night, a month or a year — two minutes from the bus station, close to the souq and the beach.
hero.photoCaption: The suite — king bed under the cove-lit ceiling, sitting room through the door

rooms.intro: Every room was refitted recently: new beds, LED-lit ceilings, marble bathrooms. Pick the style that suits you and tell us your dates.
rooms.bathroomText: Marble-clad rain shower, a granite basin with the tea tray and kettle, fresh towel sets on every bed.

suite.name: Suite
suite.desc: A king bed under a cove-lit ceiling, with a separate sitting room through the door: a wingback armchair, a low table for coffee and a round rug. The sofa room has a door back to the bedroom, so two can share without being in each other's way.
steps: Through the door: the king bed under the LED cove
The sitting room with the clock and the wingback chair
A second sofa room opens off the bedroom

double.name: Double room
double.short: One wide bed, a place to sit
double.desc: A wide double bed with a ribbed velvet headboard, curtains to the floor, and in most rooms two tub chairs with a small wooden table. Soft cove lighting, a pouf by the window, split air conditioning.
steps: The wide bed with the velvet headboard
Two tub chairs and the wooden table

twin.name: Twin room
twin.desc: Two single beds with towel sets laid out, a geometric rug, a full-height wardrobe and a desk with a kettle. One version has textured wallpaper, the other white walls and a round mirror.
steps: Two beds, towels folded on each
The open wardrobe and the rug
The white-walled twin with the desk

family.name: Family room
family.desc: A larger room with the bed set back, a pouf and a round table, and a doorway to a second space. Spotlit ceiling, plenty of floor for luggage and children.
steps: The big room from the door

flat.name: Flat
flat.desc: A living room with a grey sofa, a black coffee table and a television wall unit, and a bedroom with a wood-panelled wall and a blue rug. Taken by the month or the year as much as by the night.
steps: The living room with the sofa
The bedroom with the wood-panelled wall
The basin with the tea tray

clean.d: Guests mention the cleanliness first. The rooms were refitted recently and it shows.

central.d: On 23rd July Street: the bus station on foot, the souq and the corniche a short drive.

parking.d: Park in front of the entrance; the arcade keeps the cars out of the sun.

wifi.d: Good enough to work from the room — guests who stayed for months say so.

staff.d: A small team that answers on WhatsApp and remembers your name.

long.d: Daily, monthly and yearly — rooms and flats for people who are here for a while.

renovation.title: Refitted from the corridor in
renovation.text: The corridors got marble floors and a line of light along the walls; the stairwell a cluster of pendant lamps and gold discs. Every room was done the same way: new beds, cove ceilings, marble bathrooms. The building is the same one that has stood on 23rd July Street for years — it just looks different inside.

gallery.intro: Swipe through the rooms, the corridors and the street outside.

khareef.now: It's khareef season — Salalah's hills are green and the mist is in.
khareef.later: Next khareef: late June to early September.

salalah.intro: Salalah is the only corner of Arabia with a monsoon. From late June the hills behind the city turn green; the rest of the year it is beaches, frankincense and souqs. All of it is close.
salalah.byAir: From Salalah Airport: a short taxi ride.
salalah.byBus: From the bus station: the hotel is a few minutes' walk.
salalah.byRoad: By road from Muscat: around 10 hours on the Route 31 highway.
